limitations: No spontaneous idle flicker reproduced: baseline and corrected review both create zero elements while unchanged.
No week-long leak established; accelerated close/reopen peaks are not retained-heap measurements.
Optional memory-minimization helper unavailable; four quiescent samples show natural memory reduction, not forced-GC results.

Observed favicon map grows with distinct hosts until page close; durable commit receipts accumulate for reconciliation. Neither was demonstrated to cause this reported degradation, and no speculative authorization/storage retention changes were made.
Native Windows only; macOS and real authenticated websites not exercised by these synthetic fixtures.
